items.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.summary: Zyxel GS1900 network switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open to the exploit attackers used, researchers at Binarly found. The exploit lets anyone who can reach a switch's web management interface run commands on it without logging in. Zyxel has released new firmware for 10 GS1900 models that closes the hole. The earlier fix is the 2.90
